items.title: Correctional facility project in Östersund cancelled and Diös’ sale of the project reversed
items.summary: Correctional facility project in Östersund cancelled and Diös’ sale of the project reversed 2026-11-12 12:00:00 The Swedish Prison and Probation Service has announced that it will not proceed with the 15-year lease agreement for the planned Category 2 correctional facility on Frösön in Östersund. As a result, Diös’ SEK 117.5 million sale of the project property to Stenvalvet, announced on 12 February 2026, will be reversed and the project cancelled.
